issues.description: SQL WHERE condition on the Gemeinde.einwohner_m attribute: the problem statement (Aufgabe 06) requires counting Wanderwege that lead to Gemeinden with more than 500000 male inhabitants (problem statement: 'mehr als 500 000 männlichen Einwohnern' -> condition should be Gemeinde.einwohner_m > 500000). The solution file solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql contains the opposite comparison (AND einwohner_m < 500000). This contradiction between the problem specification and the provided solution will produce an incorrect reference solution and can cause tests or student feedback to be wrong or misleading.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the comparison in solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql so it matches the textual requirement. Replace the line 'AND einwohner_m < 500000' with 'AND einwohner_m > 500000'. After updating, run/adjust any tests or example data to ensure they expect 'mehr als 500 000' and verify the result is correct. If any tests currently expect the '<' behaviour, update them to match the corrected '>' requirement.
